pairs.subject: agent-instruction-files
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/approval/templates.ts:2 The 'templates' here are spending-rule presets a person signs, and a case-insensitive search of the approval window tree found no CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, SKILL.md or 'instruction file' (the only 'prompt' hits are a credential dialog and a face-scan prompt, and the only 'instruction' hit is a test string in replay.test.ts), so no agent instruction file exists for this UI context to own, load or write.
pairs.registryProposal: The context matched this subject on the tokens owner, templates and config, none of which refers to an instruction file; the map's use_when grounding produces false candidates for product UI contexts.
